answer_1.quote: We propose ABEX, a novel data augmentation methodology based on a novel paradigm -Abstract-and-Expand.

answer_2.quote: Table compares the generation quality of ABEX with all our baselines on the measures of perplexity, diversity (average percentage of new tokens introduced in R augmentations relative to the total tokens in the original document) and length diversity (average absolute difference in length of source and R augmentations).
